info.title: API.SH: Car and Driver
info.description: The Car and Driver API from API.SH: public Car and Driver data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Car and Driver article: title, summary, authors, section, publish/update dates, reading time, tagged vehicles, highs/lows/verdict where the review has them, the article text and its headings, and the links it contains. Identify it by `id` or `url`. Free articles come back with their full text: in list and best-of articles the text of every entry (each list item or product pick, with its headline, text and image; product picks with pros, cons and retailer prices) is placed where the list sits and is also returned under `slides`. `access` is `free` or `subscribers`; a subscriber-only article returns its public opening (`preview_text`) instead of the full text.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/caranddriver-article

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The article's numeric id (display_id from /articles or /search).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An article link on caranddriver.com (the a<number> part identifies it).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Car and Driver new-car deals and incentives
get.description:
Current manufacturer deals on new cars as Car and Driver lists them for a ZIP code: cash back and special financing (`type=buy`), lease offers (`type=lease`) or 0% APR offers (`type=zero_apr`). Each deal has the model year, make, model, trim, body style, fuel type, the offer (cash back amount and share of MSRP, APR range and per-term table with minimum credit score, or monthly lease payment, cash due, term and yearly mileage with per-trim lease pricing), start and expiry dates, the program's name, description and fine print, the MSRP range, the Car and Driver rating and awards, an image and the model's page. Offers are regional; `region_zip` is the region the ZIP maps to. Filter by make (and model), body style, fuel type and model years; sort like the site. Pages hold up to 15 deals; pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page). Makes, models, body styles and fuel types are listed by /caranddriver/v1/deal-filters.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/caranddriver-deals

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: buy (cash back and special financing), lease, or zero_apr (0% APR offers).

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code; offers depend on the region.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make name, or several separated by commas (see /deal-filters).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model name(s) of the one `make`, separated by commas (see /deal-filters).

parameters.name: body_style
parameters.description: convertible, coupe, hatchback, pickup, sedan, station wagon, suv or van (several separated by commas).

parameters.name: fuel_type
parameters.description: gas, hybrid or electric (several separated by commas).

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Model years, separated by commas (default: this year and next).

parameters.name: cash_back_only
parameters.description: With type=buy: only cash back offers.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (lowest_monthly_payment and lowest_cash_down for leases, lowest_apr for buy).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Deals per page (1-15).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (next_page from the previous answer).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Car and Driver model and model year
get.description:
One model with all its model years and the full detail of one year. Model: rating, price range, key properties (fuel, horsepower, mpg), the rankings it appears in, generations and every model year with its rating, price and page link. Selected year (the current year unless `year` is given): Car and Driver rating out of 10 with Editors' Choice, 10Best and EV of the Year flags, MSRP range, highs, lows and verdict, EPA mpg/MPGe and range, seating, cargo, drivetrains, engines, warranties, every trim with its starting MSRP, key features and style ids (use them on /specs and /compare), Car and Driver's key specs table, its ranking, review link and photo galleries. Identify the model by `model_id`, by `make` and `model`, or by a model page `url`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/caranddriver-model

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: Model id from /models (e.g. honda_civic).

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make id, with `model` (instead of model_id).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model slug, with `make` (e.g. civic, cr-v).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A model page link on caranddriver.com (instead of the ids).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Model year to detail (default the model's current year).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Car and Driver models of a make
get.description:
All models of a make as Car and Driver lists them: model id (use it as `model_id` on /model), name, current or discontinued, latest model year, body style, fuel type, horsepower, EPA mpg or MPGe, price range, Car and Driver rating out of 10 with Editors' Choice, 10Best and EV of the Year flags, overview and the model's page link. Filter by `status` and `body_style`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/caranddriver-models

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make id from /makes (e.g. honda, land-rover).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: current, discontinued or all (default all).

parameters.name: body_style
parameters.description: Only this body style (e.g. sedan, suv, hatchback, coupe, pickup, convertible, wagon, van).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Car and Driver ranking, 10 vehicles per page in rank order: model id, make, model, year, rating and award flags, price range, fuel type, combined mpg/MPGe and range, highs, lows, verdict, summary, the vehicle's other rankings and its page link; plus the ranking's summary, FAQ, sub-rankings (for category pages) and past years. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/caranddriver-ranking

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Ranking path from /rankings (e.g. /rankings/best-suvs/compact).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A rankings page link (instead of path).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (10 vehicles per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

get.summary: Car and Driver full specs of a trim
get.description:
The full specification sheet of one trim (style): MSRP, invoice and destination, trim and body, drivetrain, market class, safety rating; technical specifications grouped (engine, transmission, dimensions, weights, fuel economy, capacities, suspension, brakes, tires...), standard equipment by group, every factory option with its MSRP and invoice (colors with their color family and RGB), warranty and consumer information, crash-test results and editorial pros/cons. `sections` limits the response to some parts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/caranddriver-specs

parameters.name: style_id
parameters.description: Style id from a trim's `styles` in /model.

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Comma-separated parts to return: all (default), specs, standard, options, consumer, editorial.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
